summary: Implemented lexical optional-source selection and project-local hash-keyed range reuse, preserving complete mandatory instructions and project-owned memory.
completed_work: Select Markdown sections and Python AST symbols beyond file prefixes with explicit source ranges/line maps.
Cache only derived ranges, keyed by project root/identity, path, full source hash, query, budget, mode and extractor version.
Preserve full mandatory instructions, source freshness and total rendered budget; disclose all partial/deferred content.
Add explicit product roots without toolkit-memory fallback; protect build/plan source inputs against overwrite.
Bind planner verification to current task inputs even when task ID is unchanged.
validation: Independent rereview approved after fixing planner input overwrite and task-metadata freshness.
Final release profile passed all 46 stages, including 448 tests and cumulative/recovery/incremental package validation; remote CI must be confirmed at the published head.
decisions: Selection is deterministic lexical extraction, not semantic completeness or embeddings.
Cache only derived ranges, not source text, model answers, prompts or mutable tool results.
Fresh source bytes are still read/hashed on every build; do not infer provider-token savings from local hits.
P0 assurance gates and isolated project memory/Obsidian remain preserved.
pending_work: Reconcile current remote publication, CI and merge state before resuming; do not repeat already finished publishing.
Measure real-product retrieval and provider token/cache/latency/cost outcomes under comparable tasks before claiming savings.
Implement GenAI session telemetry, feature-detected AI/multimodal measurement and router/Ollama evaluation.
Adopt project-local memory and guards in real product tasks; no product session data belongs upstream.
risks: Unsupported source formats and unmatched queries use a disclosed prefix; large symbols/sections may be partial.
Range cache is trusted local disposable state with corruption checks, not an authentication mechanism.
Real-product effectiveness, provider cache hits/token savings and native Obsidian UI remain unmeasured.
next_action: Confirm publication/CI state, then proceed to session-scoped GenAI telemetry and measured runtime integration using the October plan.
